description: This Java class `TestInstallUtil` contains static utility methods used during testing and installation of the OpenMRS system. It provides functionalities for adding test data to the database, extracting and installing test modules from zipped files, testing URL connections, and handling resource input streams with authentication.

classes.name: TestInstallUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for testing and installing components in OpenMRS environment.

methods.name: addTestData
methods.description: Adds data to the test database by executing a MySQL source command with specified credentials and file path.

methods.name: addZippedTestModules
methods.description: Extracts .omod module files from a zipped input stream and copies them to the module repository directory, handling nested directories and cleanup.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests whether a connection can be established to a specified URL by attempting to retrieve its content.

methods.name: getResourceInputStream
methods.description: Creates an authenticated HTTP POST connection to retrieve an input stream from a given URL with provided credentials.
